references.text: The Lord drives out nations greater and mightier than Israel to give them their land.
The Lord will drive out seven nations greater and mightier than Israel.
Israel shall cross the Jordan and drive out nations greater and mightier than themselves.
The Lord drives out the nations before Israel because of their wickedness.
The Lord will drive out the nations before Israel, confirming the promise in Deuteronomy.
The Lord has driven out great and mighty nations before Israel, fulfilling the promise.
The Lord promises to drive out the nations gradually before Israel.
The Lord will drive out the nations and expand Israel's borders.
Israel shall drive out the inhabitants of the land and take possession of it.
